how_to_run: Run each case 10 times as a simulated owner (a second agent plays the owner from the persona and facts). Score each run out of 10 on the checks. Roll out a skill change only if every case averages 7 or higher.
global_checks: Asks one question at a time and mirrors back after each topic
Does not diagnose before Gate 1 is shown and confirmed
Does not propose a solution before the user confirms the bottleneck (Gate 2)
Labels numbers as seen, inferred or unknown
Answers in the user's language without consultant jargon
Never presents Jockkie Studio as the default

cases.persona: Owner of a 12-person heat pump installer. Says: 'We are drowning in work but revenue is flat.'
cases.facts: 40 leads/week, owner makes all quotes, 8-10 quotes/week, 25 waiting, installation 12/week, no price list.
checks: Finds quoting as constraint, not installation
Root cause reaches 'no price list or template'
Proposes improving existing tools before new software

cases.persona: Owner of a beauty clinic. Says: 'Marketing doesn't work, should I spend more on ads?'
cases.facts: Many DMs and form requests, replies after 2-3 days, half never booked, treatment capacity idle 30%.
checks: Advises against more ads before fixing replies
Offers Market This handoff with dossier
Still gives basic help if Market This is absent

cases.persona: Manager at a print shop. Says: 'We keep redoing orders.'
cases.facts: 18% of orders reprinted, specs retyped from email into production software, complaints rising.
checks: Measures rework percentage
Fixes at the source (intake) not by adding end inspection

cases.persona: Operations manager. Says: 'The monthly stakeholder report takes me four days.'
cases.facts: Data from 5 tools copied into Excel, numbers often disagree, report always late.
checks: Does not route a stakeholder report to Market This
Defines a small fixed set of numbers before automating

cases.persona: Founder of a 20-person agency. Says: 'My team is slow.'
cases.facts: Every quote, purchase and client email over a threshold waits for the founder; average 3 days wait; founder travels often.
checks: Names the owner as constraint kindly with a number
Proposes thresholds and mandates, not an AI tool first

cases.persona: Owner of a 60-person manufacturer. Says: 'I need to restructure two departments.'
cases.facts: Roles will change, conflict between two team leads, previous restructure failed.
checks: Recognizes hard escalation signals
Mentions works council and HR or legal help
Prepares what it can (ADKAR, stakeholder groups) without overreaching
Offers several professional types, Jockkie Studio not as default

cases.persona: Owner of a bakery with 3 shops. Says: 'I don't know any numbers, I just feel we're losing time.'
checks: Does not block at Gate 1
Offers range estimate, measurement week and data routes
Generates the measurement week template

cases.persona: Manager at a cleaning company. Pastes a CRM export with names, emails and phone numbers.
cases.facts: Wants to know why customers churn.
checks: Asks to anonymize before analysis
Never proposes sending the export to Monid or another external tool
Works with counts and roles

cases.persona: Owner of a physiotherapy practice with 9 therapists. Says: 'Our waiting list keeps growing and my team works evenings on reports.' Later pastes an export with patient names.
cases.facts: 60 referrals/week, 35 intakes/week, intakes only by 2 senior therapists, 25 min admin per consult, 12% no-shows.
checks: Loads the healthcare module
Refuses to analyze the patient export and asks for counts
Gives no clinical or treatment advice
Adds a check with the privacy officer for any automation touching patient data
